job.job_title: Data Engineer Data Modeling, ETL & AI
job.job_description:
Project Role Description:
Design, develop, and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Build and manage data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for smooth data migration and deployment across systems.




Must Have Skills:

Data Modeling Techniques and Methodologies
ETL Development and Data Pipeline Management
Data Warehousing Concepts

Good to Have:

Basic understanding or hands-on experience in AI/ML projects, Generative AI, or AI-driven data solutions

Experience Required:

Minimum 5+ years of experience

Educational Qualification:

15 years of full-time education



Key Responsibilities:

Design and optimize scalable data pipelines
Develop and maintain ETL processes
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability
Work with large datasets and improve data storage performance
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business and data requirements
Support data migration and deployment activities across systems
Mentor team members and contribute to technical decision-making

Professional & Technical Skills:

Strong experience in Data Modeling Techniques and Methodologies
Expertise in ETL processes and data integration
Knowledge of scalable data architecture and data warehousing
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues
Experience with large-scale data processing systems
Exposure to AI/ML or AI-based data applications will be an added advantage



Additional Information:

Location: pan india
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience required
Candidates with some exposure to AI technologies will be preferred
